name: Sagarmatha National Park
description: Sagarmatha National Park covers about 1,148 square kilometres of the Himalayas in eastern Nepal, rising from deep river valleys at 2,845 metres to the summit of Mount Everest at 8,848 metres. Visitors find glaciers, jagged peaks and rare wildlife such as the snow leopard and lesser panda. The park is also home to the Sherpas, whose distinctive culture shapes life in these high valleys.
